selected_script.angle: Stop rubbing dried bird droppings on car paint with a dry napkin that spreads chalky grit and risks dragging residue; use the Chemical Guys kit with Mr Pink foam, the TORQ Foam Blaster, green chenille mitt, blue microfiber towel, and camo bucket for a safer-looking same-spot clean.
selected_script.hook: I tried wiping dried bird poop off my hood with a napkin, and it just smeared gritty residue across the paint.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up on a dried white bird dropping stuck to a dark car hood; a hand uses a dry fast-food napkin and the residue barely moves, leaving chalky streaks.
timeline.3-6s: The same napkin keeps rubbing harder on the same spot, visibly spreading gritty white smears wider across the glossy paint while the hand pauses in frustration.
timeline.6-10s: The Chemical Guys 16-piece kit enters naturally beside the hood; the green and black TORQ Foam Blaster applies real foam from Mr Pink, the green chenille mitt gently loosens the same stain, a blue microfiber towel wipes the area clean, and the camera tilts to show the cleaned patch beside the still-dirty edge with a light spoken CTA: 'Check it out for your next wash.'

scenes.promptText: Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style, natural garage driveway lighting, no text on screen. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity for the Chemical Guys 16-Piece Car Washing and Interior Detailing Kit: preserve the limited edition blue-white-black-gray camo 4.5 gallon detailing bucket with large circular Chemical Guys logo, the green and black TORQ Foam Blaster 6 Pro with clear reservoir and logo, the Mr Pink bottle, multicolor Chemical Guys bottles, bright green chenille wash mitt, blue microfiber towels, blue applicator pads, green bristle wheel brush, and black Dirt Trap disc. Do not change product color, shape, material, proportions, logo position, texture, labels, or visible structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, or functions. Timeline: 0-3s: begin with an extreme close-up of a credible cleaning pain on the same car surface, a dried white bird dropping stuck to a glossy dark car hood with dust around it; a hand tries the familiar ordinary method of wiping it with a dry fast-food napkin, but it visibly fails, barely lifting anything and leaving chalky residue. 3-6s: stay on the same tight handheld angle and continue the failed napkin method; the hand rubs harder, the white gritty smear spreads wider across the hood, the napkin starts to crumple, and the effort looks frustrating but realistic. 6-10s: the product enters naturally from the side of the hood, with the Chemical Guys camo bucket and kit visible nearby at correct scale; the hand uses the real green and black TORQ Foam Blaster with Mr Pink soap to lay a normal layer of foam on the exact same stained area, then gently works it with the bright green chenille wash mitt and wipes with a blue microfiber towel. Finish by tilting the phone camera to show credible result proof: the cleaned glossy patch beside a small untouched dirty edge for before-after contrast, normal water beads and remaining realistic reflections, not magically perfect. End with a casual spoken light CTA only: 'Check it out for your next wash.' Forbid UI, subtitles, stickers, text overlays, watermarks, floating graphics, invented accessories, product drift, magical instant cleanup, smoke, glowing chemicals, exaggerated bubbling, impossible shine, or changing the car surface between shots.
